evidence.why: AWS secret credentials are read without a public prefix inside a server-only API route handler (runtime nodejs), not in client code.
Client component only calls fetch() to /api/upload and /api/upload/presigned; it never constructs the S3 SDK or holds secret keys.

controls_present: API route handlers isolate privileged S3 credentials
client only receives presigned URL / response JSON, not raw credentials
other_classes_observed: presigned PUT URL returned without expiry validation client-side
no server-side authorization check on upload/presigned endpoints
